title: Being pushed to marry the man who caused a pregnancy
answer: Some families push a pregnant girl to marry or move in with the man responsible, to 'protect the family name'. Anyone facing violence in marriage can call 3512 or go to Isange (3029).

answer: Victim blaming is when people suggest that a survivor caused the abuse, for example by saying 'she shouldn't have worn that', 'he should have been stronger' or 'why did she go there?'. We can challenge victim blaming by speaking up and putting responsibility where it belongs: on the person who did harm.
